# Alfayad Shameer

Alfayad Shameer (also known as Fayad, Alfayad, Alfayad S, and Alfayad-s) is a full-stack and mobile app developer and UI/UX designer currently working in Bengaluru at Codeteak Technologies. He is from Alappuzha, Kerala, India. His portfolio is https://alfayad.clawdage.com.

## Names

- Full name: Alfayad Shameer
- Common names / aliases: Fayad, Alfayad, Alfayad S, Alfayad-s

## Work

- Codeteak Technologies (https://codeteak.com), on-site in Bengaluru; company also in Dubai. Full-stack developer and UI/UX designer. He designs the interface and builds the web and mobile products with the team. Started April 2025.
- Freelance full-stack and mobile product work, remote. Includes APIs, payments, and budget-friendly website and app builds.
- Brototype internship, MERN stack, January 2024 to December 2025.

He is open for freelance work from Bengaluru and remotely. Email alfayadshameer056@gmail.com or book at https://hirefayad.vercel.app.

## Services

- Full-stack web development (React, Next.js, Node.js, MERN)
- Mobile app development (React Native)
- UI/UX design
- API development and AI integration
- Budget-friendly / affordable product builds for startups and small businesses
- Hire developer in Bengaluru / Bangalore or remote

## What he builds

Web apps, mobile apps, and AI products. Stack: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, React Native, Next.js, Node.js, Express, NestJS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, and AI integration.
